parts.note_add: Catalogue colour code 00 is black (S-005 Engine-Chassis catalogue p113, fig 4400A-1). Adjusting screw for cable tension is on the lever; set so the rear brakes lock at 6-8 notches under 100 N (22 lb) at the grip (S-038 p8).

Catalogue colour code 00 is black (S-005 Engine-Chassis catalogue p113, fig 4400A-1).

Still sold new by Atkins Rotary as Mazda 1480-44-150A, fits all 81-85 (in stock, USD 95.50, 2026-09). Atkins says clip 0118-44-375 fits one per rear cable, i.e. the two clips belong at the rear-cable ends, not the front cable; check on the car.

FA54-44-410A is the rear-drum (S and GS) right cable; the GSL disc-brake car uses FA16-44-410B (S-005 p113). Atkins Rotary lists FA54-44-410A at USD 80, out of stock (2026-09); the cable hooks to the operating lever on the rear brake shoe (S-002 Section 11 p9).

FA54-44-420A is the rear-drum (S and GS) left cable; the GSL disc-brake car uses FA16-44-420A (S-005 p113). Atkins Rotary lists FA54-44-420A as NLA (2026-09), so a good used cable or the front cable plus a rebuild is the route; the cable hooks to the operating lever on the rear brake shoe (S-002 Section 11 p9).
